why: The two crossed boxes always sit side by side and move round: top, left, bottom, right. After the right side they return to the top. Option 1 has the two top boxes crossed. Options 4 and 5 use boxes that are not next to each other, which never happens in the series.
trick: If a pair of shaded boxes moves round a 2x2 grid, after four steps it is back at the start.
